title: On Bursting along one thin seam
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：burst　|　正文 349 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 burst 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the pipe ① burst along one thin seam without a word of thanks, and every villager in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the pipe ② bursts along one thin seam at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ burst along one thin seam at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ burst along one thin seam before — a line in the survey for October 1972 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Bursting along one thin seam without a word of thanks, the ranger said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the pipe ever ⑥ bursts into small pieces on the road at once before the October rains, nobody in the valley would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ burst into small pieces on the road at once and never speak of it again.

By 1985 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the survey, and a second pipe ⑧ bursts into small pieces on the road without a word of thanks every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the valley said a word; ⑨ The pipe burst along one thin seam again in 1988, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To burst along one thin seam, my mother said in 1990, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the valley remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the valley forgets, the pipe bursts along one thin seam at once again and the pipe must burst along one thin seam without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 裂开（一般过去式 burst along one thin seam：1978 年那根管子头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 裂开（一般现在 bursts along one thin seam：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 裂开（不定式 to burst along one thin seam：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 裂开（过去完成时 had burst along one thin seam：1972 年十月的踏勘记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 裂开（动名词 bursting along one thin seam 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 迸出（bursts into small pieces on the road：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真迸出在路上迸成碎片）
G. v. 迸出（burst into small pieces on the road：let it 之后的原形，指随它去在路上迸成碎片）
H. v. 裂开（后段两处：后来的那根管子照例 bursts into small pieces on the road，而那根管子在 1988 年又一次 burst along one thin seam）

answers.why: burst 意为“裂开”，1978 年那根管子不图一句谢裂开顺着一道细缝裂开，那是山谷里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 burst。
burst 意为“裂开”，自那以后那根管子二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 bursts。
burst 意为“裂开”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯裂开顺着一道细缝裂开”，此处为不定式 to burst along one thin seam。
burst 意为“裂开”，踏勘记录里 十月 那行字说明早在 1985 年之前就有人裂开过，故用过去完成时 had burst。
burst 意为“裂开”，那根管子说“裂开顺着一道细缝裂开这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 bursting along one thin seam 作主语。
burst 意为“迸出”，叔叔说的是“万一那根管子真迸出在路上迸成碎片”，if 从句里用一般现在 bursts into small pieces on the road。
burst 意为“迸出”，老手们的规矩是“随它迸出在路上迸成碎片”（let it burst into small pieces on the road），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
burst 意为“裂开”，后来的那根管子每个季节都照例迸出在路上迸成碎片，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 bursts。
burst 意为“裂开”，那根管子在 1988 年在无人肯做的时候又一次不图一句谢裂开顺着一道细缝裂开，用一般过去式 burst 叙述。
burst 意为“裂开”，结尾那句是母亲 1990 年的话：要裂开顺着一道细缝裂开，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和山谷记住的那一件。
